description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: npm run check && npm run build succeed; main.ts creates BrowserWindow 1200x800 with contextIsolation=true, nodeIntegration=false, preload path set

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DocumentList renders empty state 'No documents imported yet.'; App.tsx left panel width 280px hosts DocumentList

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel submits via onAsk -> window.knowledgeBase.qa.ask on Enter/click; preload exposes qa.ask IPC channel

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService.ensureDirectories() creates dataDir + documents + index; main.ts uses app.getPath('userData')/knowledge-base-data; node smoke verified mkdir
